text:
Mira: thanks folks — quick follow-up from today's all-hands about the API/Console/Optimize timelines. two concrete asks: confirm (1) adaptive-batching beta window for Hosted API and Dedicated, (2) console per-route cost breakdown visibility rollout, (3) Optimize suggestions UI release status. trying to coordinate comms and docs.
Ana: thx Mira. high level: api adaptive-batching -> late Q2, console cost breakdown -> early Q3, Optimize UI -> canary in late Q2. details below.
Mira: can you confirm weeks? marketing needs dates for docs and sample apps.
Ana: adaptive-batching beta: target start 2024-06-24, open beta 4 weeks after. console cost-viz: gated by backend billing tags, target 2024-07-15 rollout to internal first. Optimize suggestions UI: canary 2024-06-30, broader launch after metrics review (2 wks).
Jamal: implementation note: adaptive-batching has a decoder-side change + KV-cache touchpoints. we'll need a short compatibility window for Dedicated. planning: canary on a small fleet first week of canary date.
Trevor: infra ask — Dedicated customers with pinned models need a migration guard. we'll add a toggle in the console -> rollout requires support from eng-sre to monitor latency targets.
Ella: DevEx: we'll draft a short "what changed" snippet for the SDKs once canary starts. do we have an example config?
Jamal: example config we plan to surface: `"batch_policy": {"mode":"adaptive","max_latency_ms":15,"min_batch":4}`. we'll publish in SDK docs.
Kevin: marketing note — we need a feature matrix row for console cost breakdown (per-route) with screenshots. who's owning the screenshots for the canary?
Mira: Kevin put me and Ella as owners for screenshots. Jamal can you share a small test route we can use?
Jamal: will publish a reproducible config and a small node script tomorrow.
Trevor: deploy-bot: canary deployment scheduled: prod-canary-cluster on 2024-06-24 03:00 UTC. :rocket:
deploy-bot: note: rollback window 2 hours, health checks enabled (p90 latency, error-rate spike).
Ana: quick clarification — does the Optimize suggestions UI require data-retention changes (we might need longer eval logs for the QA run)?
Ella: Optimize team said yes, need +30 days retention for prompt evals during canary to measure regressions. ops/security ok?
Trevor: ops signed off, but need a JIRA for retention opt-in per org. create ticket and tag eng-infra.
Mira: action items: (1) Jamal publish config + node script by EOD tomorrow, (2) Kevin/Ella screenshots for canary demo by 2024-06-26, (3) Trevor open retention JIRA and link to canary plan, (4) Ana to announce exact dates in next comms.
Kevin: noted. I'll sync with Growth to time the doc release.
Jamal: quick note — adaptive-batching beta won't change token semantics but may alter request ordering in edge cases; we'll add a short blurb in the SDK breakage section.
Mira: perfect — thanks. if there are no blockers I'll archive these action items in the all-hands follow-up doc after Trevor's JIRA. :thumbsup:
Ana: thanks team. will ping owners 1 week before canary to confirm readiness.
Ella: small UX ask — can we surfacing a "beta" flag in the console route UI so early customers know it's experimental?
Jamal: doable, we'll add a subtle pill with tooltip.
Trevor: last message: infra will run an extended load test on 2024-06-22 to validate batch shapes; expect ~6h test window. will post results in eng-sre.
Mira: great — closing thread here. I'll follow up with a short summary doc and link back to this thread.
